Disconnect your pad to edit your touch controls Wait for the pending operations to complete Please enable notifications from Home to continue Please close the current game before starting another Help Support •How do I use Lemuroid?
Copy all your ROMs files into a directory on your device and select it within Lemuroid. This directory is allowed to have subdirectories. After the scan completes you should see your games.

•Why aren\'t my games detected?
If your games are compressed, try uncompressing them. If this doesn\'t work try putting ROMs into separate directories, one for each system with the following names: $SYSTEMS. It looks like the Libretro core has experienced an unexpected issue. If it\'s persistent please try the following:\n \n\u2022 Disable auto-save and re-run the game \n\u2022 Go into Android settings and clear the app cache \n\u2022 Go into Lemuroid settings and perform a Factory Reset \n\n If none of the above works, it might be possible that this Game/Core is not supported by this device.
